prompt:
Create one high-fidelity visual storyboard of FOUR MOBILE PAGE DESIGNS for the AOHYS personal engineering portfolio, "Firma en movimiento". Wide landscape 1536x1024 canvas, divided into four equal flat 360px-wide mobile website viewports with 24px pale neutral gutters. Each viewport is its own 360x960 vertically scrolling page excerpt. No phone hardware, no perspective, no captions outside the screens. These are four DIFFERENT pages of the same site, not four alternate designs. Use the first reference for the exact humanist typography, white/lightness, dark warm brown text, honey buttons and rich tapering olive brush material. The screens must be sparse and breathable with 20px body type, 36px page headings, plenty of white space; coherent craftsmanship, never tiny text crammed in. Only a small organic brush detail per page, NOT a brush around every block. Reference 2 supplies the real NutriPlan illustration; retain its natural warm watercolor image.

Each screen has the same tiny aohys wordmark at top left and "Menú" at top right.

SCREEN 1: TRABAJO. Title "El trabajo." Below, a concise profile link "Productos que he construido". Then five generous typographic project rows separated by space, no boxes: "The Barber Central" with "Reservas y operación del negocio."; "NutriPlan" with "Consulta y seguimiento del paciente."; "ETERIA" with "Del primer contacto al evento."; "Casa Roca" with "Hospitalidad y reservaciones."; "AOHYS" with "Publicar mi trabajo y cómo lo hago." Small arrows signal opening cases. One miniature actual NutriPlan watercolor image can accompany active row NutriPlan, not all five cards. A slender olive brush stroke flows down the right margin, changing thickness naturally. All five product names must be visible. Bottom quiet text "Trayectoria profesional →".

SCREEN 2: PROJECT CASE. Breadcrumb "Trabajo / NutriPlan". Large "NutriPlan." Title underneath "La atención sigue entre consultas." A big clean rectangle containing only the real NutriPlan watercolor illustration of nutritionist and patient from reference 2, about screen y230–430, not the full website screenshot squeezed. Below, heading "Qué construí" and readable 3-line paragraph "Consulta clínica, planes de alimentación y un portal para acompañar al paciente." Below a quiet list "Mediciones y progreso", "Ejercicio y seguimiento", "Acceso por organización y rol". Olive textured sweep supports the image's outside edge. One honey text action near bottom "Ver decisiones técnicas →". This is a software engineering case, no fabricated patient data or outcomes.

SCREEN 3: ARCHITECTURE / METHOD. Title "Cómo lo hago." Subhead "Una reserva no debe empalmarse." A simple vertically read semantic diagram with only three olive outlined nodes and arrows: "Mostrar disponibilidad" → "Validar la reserva" → "Confirmar al cliente". Plenty of whitespace. Then heading "Primero, las reglas." Paragraph "Defino el problema y la arquitectura. Divido el trabajo, integro las piezas y reviso el resultado." Small note "Los agentes ayudan a ejecutar. La responsabilidad es mía." Warm honey underline on "reglas", restrained olive brush at bottom. Do not fill this screen with brand logos or technology badges.

SCREEN 4: CV. Title "Trayectoria." Intro "Full-stack, con especial fortaleza en frontend." The first expanded role "Tala" / "Senior Frontend Developer" / "2023 — presente" with short text "Flujos para soporte, cobranza y corrección de préstamos." Then six compact but readable rows "Drift · 2022–2023", "Prenuvo · 2021–2022", "Datazone / AutoZone · 2020–2021", "Accenture · 2018–2020", "NEORIS / CEMEX · 2018", "AOHYS · 2015–presente". All names fully legible. AOHYS is ongoing founder work, not an employer ending in2015. Honey pill "Ver CV completo". A tiny textured olive mark beside Tala acts like a timeline indicator. No invented metrics or claims.

Common palette ONLY portfolio white #FFFFFF, dark brown #473C33, olive #ABC270, honey #FEC868, apricot #FDA769. The provided product artwork retains actual color. Preserve the signature's real dry-brush strands and delicacy; no generic icon-card grids, no dense dashboard styling, no exaggerated 3D. Deliver four elegant mobile screens with accurate Spanish typography and a clear content hierarchy.
